name: pa_consolidated_statute
description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes — Pennsylvania state law — by citation. "18 Pa.C.S. 2502" is murder; "75 Pa.C.S. 3802" is DUI. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does 18 Pa.C.S. 2502 say" or to check a Pennsylvania statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "2502" or "3802". The first two digits are the chapter.
